supplier.locator: Definitions 5.1, 6.1, 6.6, 6.8, 6.15, 6.18, 6.19 and 6.22; pp.1248,1253,1256,1261,1263-1266; Appendix A.2/A.3 and natural extension discussion pp.1324-1325

assertion.statement: Nilcharacters have a fixed filtered nilmanifold, a polynomial orbit, a unit-vector-valued bounded Lipschitz limit function and a standard vertical character; equality of degree-s symbols is witnessed by a degree at most s-1 tensor quotient.
assertion.objects: Connected simply connected nilpotent G, lattice Gamma, rational multidegree groups G_a, chi=F(g Gamma), symbols on Z^m.
assertion.hypotheses: G_a trivial outside a<=1; commutator and descending axioms; F vertical of standard real homomorphism eta integral on Gamma_top.
assertion.quantifiers: For every fixed s,m and each such nilcharacter and tuple of integer homomorphisms; in the limit definition, vertical equivariance holds for every x in *(G/Gamma) and every t in *G_top, using the natural ultrapower extension of standard eta.
assertion.parameter_range: s,m>=1; arbitrary integer inputs and all polynomial coefficients allowed by the definition.
assertion.uniformity: Fixed filtered nilmanifold and bounded Lipschitz norm in the limit formulation.
assertion.constants: No numeric norm threshold is introduced; vector dimension is a fixed finite integer.
assertion.normalizations: Complex conjugation is componentwise; e(t)=exp(2 pi i t); total-degree symbols after pullback.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Lower-degree or trivial top filtration is allowed; it yields a constant or lower-degree representation without a separate assumption.
assertion.limit_order: All standard structural data precede the limit polynomial and bounded test-function family.

supplier.locator: Section 3, pp.1242-1243: exponential coordinates, connected real generated group and finite-generated discrete subgroup cocompactness; remaining compactness argument proved in local Lemma 2.

assertion.statement: A connected subgroup generated by finitely many connected rational subgroups is closed, simply connected and rational; a central connected rational quotient has the image lattice.
assertion.objects: M/Lambda, subgroups J_i, their lattice generators, H=<J_i>_R and central C subset H.
assertion.hypotheses: M is connected simply connected nilpotent; Lambda discrete cocompact; each J_i connected with J_i intersect Lambda cocompact; C rational and central.
assertion.quantifiers: For every finite list of such J_i and every such C.
assertion.parameter_range: Any finite dimension and finite list; includes trivial subgroups.
assertion.uniformity: All resulting groups and lattice data depend only on the fixed original groups, not the orbit coefficients.
assertion.constants: The lattice generator argument uses one finite radius 2R+1 from a compact fundamental set.
assertion.normalizations: Connected real generated group is the exponential of the generated Lie algebra; lattice is intersection with Lambda, not an invented conjugate.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Trivial quotient allowed. Rationality, not centrality alone, is required for discreteness of the image lattice.
assertion.limit_order: Subgroups and quotients are constructed once before any sequence of polynomial maps.

assertion.statement: Pointwise products of polynomial maps between I-filtered groups remain polynomial; constants in G_0 and filtered homomorphisms preserve the stated derivative conditions.
assertion.objects: g(n)g(0)^-1, conjugation by q, and the ordered A/B/C Taylor factors into K.
assertion.hypotheses: The source and target filtrations satisfy nesting and commutator axioms; every factor is polynomial for the same filtration.
assertion.quantifiers: For every finite product and every input.
assertion.parameter_range: I=N^s for normalization and I=N for the triple orbit; all integer inputs.
assertion.uniformity: An algebraic closure statement, independent of coefficients or interval length.
assertion.exceptional_cases: A constant factor need only lie in G_0; after normalization all auxiliary factors lie in K_1=K_0.
assertion.limit_order: First prove the auxiliary filtration valid, then apply product closure; no reliance on the desired multilinearity lemma.

assertion.statement: A multidegree-at-most-one polynomial has an ordered Taylor expansion product u_a^(n^a), with u_a in G_a; normalizing h(0)=1 removes the constant factor.
assertion.objects: h:Z^s->G, a in {0,1}^s, coefficients u_a and a fixed total order extending the partial order.
assertion.hypotheses: h is polynomial in the multidegree filtration and that filtration is supported on the finite cube downset.
assertion.quantifiers: For each h there is the stated expansion valid for every n.
assertion.parameter_range: All s>=1 and all integer n, including negative n.
assertion.uniformity: Number and order of factors depend only on s; coefficients may be arbitrary.
assertion.constants: Exactly 2^s-1 possible nonconstant factors; no estimate.
assertion.normalizations: Binomial n_j choose a_j equals n_j for a_j=1 and 1 for a_j=0.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Zero/trivial coefficients give identity factors; constant coefficient equals one.
assertion.limit_order: Normalize h before using this expansion; then construct the triple product factor by factor.

assertion.statement: The connected descending auxiliary groups are rational; K0=K1=H1 is a valid ambient group and H_s is central; their central quotient is a rational nilmanifold of degree at most s-1.
assertion.objects: A_a(u)=(u,u,u), B_a(u)=(u,u,1), C_a(u)=(u,1,u), H_i generated by weights >=i, Delta=H1 intersect Gamma^3.
assertion.hypotheses: Original G_a rational and [G_a,G_b] subset G_(a+b); original cube downset makes first-coordinate-two commutators vanish.
assertion.quantifiers: All indices 0<=i<=s+1, all generators and all group elements obtained from them.
assertion.parameter_range: Any s>=1, including s=1 when the quotient is trivial.
assertion.uniformity: Groups and lattices fixed independently of the polynomial orbit.
assertion.constants: No discarded generators or finite-index replacement; the lattice is the exact intersection.
assertion.normalizations: Weights are >=i; K0=K1; H_s={(uv,u,v)} with u,v in G_top.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The original G0 need not be taut; no claim H0=H1 is made for the unnormalized exact-weight construction.
assertion.limit_order: Establish connected rationality and commutators before invoking the polynomial closure theorem or forming the quotient.

assertion.statement: Bounded normalization preserves the represented sequence and the same standard vertical character, and the three-fold test function descends with a fixed Lipschitz bound.
assertion.objects: g0=q gamma, h=q^-1 g gamma^-1, F_q(x)=F(qx), T_q=F_q tensor conjugate F_q tensor conjugate F_q.
assertion.hypotheses: q chosen from a fixed compact representative set; G_a normal in G0; original F has unit norm and standard vertical eta.
assertion.quantifiers: For every polynomial coefficient set and every point of the auxiliary nilmanifold.
assertion.parameter_range: Arbitrary orbit coefficients; q remains in the fixed compact set.
assertion.uniformity: The quotient and Lipschitz comparison constants are independent of g, q and the varying interval length.
assertion.constants: Bounds depend on fixed geometric data and original Lip(F); tensor factors have unit norm.
assertion.normalizations: eta(qtq^-1)=eta(t), proved by integer-valued continuity on connected G0 and lattice generation; no changed lattice.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No centrality of G_top in original G0 is assumed; centrality is established in the auxiliary K.
assertion.limit_order: Normalize using bounded q, then descend the invariant test function to the fixed quotient.

assertion.statement: The exact lower-degree representation transfers to limit data, and precomposition with any fixed integer homomorphism preserves the degree bound and yields the original symbol equality.
assertion.objects: Fixed quotient K/H_s and its lattice, limit polynomial P, bounded Lipschitz limit test function, homomorphism (L1,L1prime,L2,...,Ls).
assertion.hypotheses: Original structural data are standard; F is a bounded Lipschitz limit function with a standard vertical character; coefficients may be limit coefficients.
assertion.quantifiers: For every such limit family and every fixed tuple of homomorphisms; the defining unit-norm and vertical identities quantify over all limit points and all limit top-group elements. Standard-point-only identities do not imply the exact transfer used here.
assertion.parameter_range: All integer inputs; arbitrary standard s,m>=1.
assertion.uniformity: The same quotient and metric constants for all members; no choice of a new nilmanifold from each large coefficient.
assertion.constants: Exact representation, no correlation loss, approximation error or norm rescaling.
assertion.normalizations: Symbol relation is lower-degree tensor quotient, with the two required conjugations.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Limit representatives may be restricted to an ultrafilter-large set on which the exact defining identities hold.
assertion.limit_order: Fix structural data, normalize each polynomial within one compact set, use the uniform geometric construction, and then take the limit.
